additional_info.subject: Firmware update via SCB
additional_info.body:
Dear colleagues,
We are experiencing issues when trying to update the firmware from the SCB for the chargers with ID zlusYd and 8qDDVx.
For the charger zlusYd running version 6.1.3, when initiating a Firmware Rollout, the message "Rollout is already initiated" appears, although it still gives us the option to proceed with the update.
For the charger 8qDDVx running version 7.0.5, the Firmware Rollout does not execute when initiated.
Best Regards,
Lodhar Aedo L.
SIEMENS S.A.
RC-CL SI DG CS&D
Alonso de Cordova 4580
Santiago, Chile
Mobil: +56 9 57986913
Email:lodhar.aedo@siemens.com

additional_info.body:
Dear colleagues,
We have detected some issues with the Sicharge D charger bkob1U.
These are as follows:
When a vehicle is charging, occasionally one of the charger plugs becomes unavailable. This always happens when more than one vehicle is connected to the charger.
In the last few charging sessions, an attempt was made to stop the charge, but the Sicharge continued charging. The display shows "charging finished," but the process does not stop.
